mapper.select: SELECT n.notification_id, n.recipient_member_id, n.notification_type, n.settlement_id, n.actor_name, n.gathering_name, n.amount, n.currency_code, n.read_at, n.created_at FROM notifications n WHERE n.recipient_member_id = #{memberId} AND n.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY n.created_at DESC, n.notification_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notifications n WHERE n.recipient_member_id = #{memberId} AND n.read_at IS NULL AND n.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT s.payer_member_id, payer.display_name AS payer_name, a.appointment_name AS gathering_name, s.total_amount, t.currency_code FROM settlements s JOIN appointments a ON a.appointment_id = s.appointment_id JOIN wallet_transfers t ON t.transfer_id = s.source_transfer_id JOIN members payer ON payer.member_id = s.payer_member_id WHERE s.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT am.member_id, m.display_name, sm.share_amount, sm.request_status FROM settlement_members sm JOIN appointment_members am ON am.appointment_member_id = sm.appointment_member_id JOIN members m ON m.member_id = am.member_id WHERE sm.settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND sm.request_status <> 'NOT_REQUESTED' AND sm.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sm.appointment_member_id
